# Spire Remote Patient Monitoring System

[Website](https://www.wellinks.com/spire)

Spire Remote Patient Monitoring System is a continuous wearable cardiorespiratory monitor used in outpatient cardiopulmonary workflows such as chronic disease management and virtual pulmonary programs. It captures respiration, pulse (PPG), and activity from a wearable tag and collects spirometry, pulse oximetry, medication-adherence, and mobile app data.
